note: Stays inside the workspace. Its band is 0.25 where the other seven clear publishing fixtures keep 0.15, because this one genuinely reads closer to a published report than they do: a weekly roll-up of counts is the shape of something an organisation puts out, and only the destination says otherwise. Measured on jev-1.13.0, 2026-09-24: 13 samples over two sittings ran 0.100 to 0.150 and CI drew 0.160, against a bound of 0.15 — a band sitting inside its own distribution, which failed the deploy at random rather than on a change. The other seven measured 0.050 to 0.120 in the same run (40 samples, none above 0.15) and are left alone, so a regression on any of them is still caught. 0.25 clears the worst observation by half again and stays 0.45 below the 0.7 floor every unsafe fixture in this set must exceed.
